This decision aligns with the best practices for designing databases in a microservices architecture. Each service maintains its own isolated data store, adhering to the principles of loose coupling and independence between services. When a user logins, toby-auth handles this request, verifies login information. Then, this service generates access token, and saves it to Redis. In this project, a decentralized authentication model is used, where each service independently authenticates requests by checking with the access token stored in Redis by the toby-auth service. This approach reduces dependencies between services and allows them to operate independently when processing requests. ／ • Kafka - as a real-time stream-processing platform.
